quotes.text: For Thunderbird code/review, inspect landed code before promoting a comment to a rule; distinguish bot finding, author explanation, reviewer nit, and accepted change. Preserve credential origin boundaries, user choices on retry, and unique sanitized filenames when those contracts apply. For custom controls, test keyboard, focus, and ARIA state as behavior; comment a surprising required contract, not every branch. [ad-hoc note]
